title: Vegan Black Bean Burgers
subtitle: with corn and coriander, served in a sweet bun
description: Mashed black beans are mixed with sauteed red onion, capsicum, chilli, corn, breadcrumbs, cumin and coriander, shaped into patties, floured and pan-fried. Serve in a bun with the usual burger trimmings.

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the finely chopped onion, capsicum and chilli for about 10 minutes until golden and the liquid evaporates. Add the garlic and fry for about 1 minute more until it starts to colour. Transfer to a bowl.
Mash the drained beans to a smooth puree in a large bowl and add the fried vegetables. Add the corn kernels, breadcrumbs, cumin, coriander and salt and mix.
Spread the flour on a plate. Shape the mixture into flat patties and dip both sides in the flour.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat and fry 2 patties on both sides until browned. Repeat with the remaining patties, using 1 tbsp oil for every 2 patties.
Serve in buns with ketchup, pickles, tomato, lettuce and any other trimmings.
